tools.name: resolve-library-id
tools.description: Resolves a package/product name to a Context7-compatible library ID and returns matching candidates with benchmarks and metadata.

libraryName.description: Name of the library, framework, or package (e.g. 'react', 'next.js', 'playwright')

query.description: Optional context or topic to refine matching (e.g. 'app router', 'hooks')

tools.name: query-docs
tools.description: Retrieves and queries up-to-date documentation and code examples from Context7 for any library using its resolved library ID.

query.description: The specific query, API name, or concept to look up (e.g. 'useEffect cleanup', 'route handlers')
